claimed_surface: Bounded independent v0.33 review of independently authored SQL; no release approval.
Scalar/EXISTS/IN-subquery labels, native output types/modifiers, collation composition, canonical PostgreSQL rendering, and statement-wide parameters.
Recursive-reference contexts and nested CTE visibility/shadowing.
Focused corpus/native-oracle wiring and CI inspection; LLM review does not discharge Lean/theorem or semantic claims.

actual_attempts.name: nested labels, exact modifiers, duplicate output ORDER BY and unknown finalization
actual_attempts.method: Frozen copied CLI plus PostgreSQL 16.15 psql gdesc for source and canonical SQL; gdesc does not execute SELECT. PostgreSQL type aliases reconciled explicitly.
actual_attempts.result: No admitted native-analysis error or source/canonical descriptor discrepancy found.

actual_attempts.name: collation composition
actual_attempts.method: Product probes for literal/NULL/NAME/scalar-SubLink C/POSIX/indeterminate-child inputs through COALESCE, CASE, concatenation, IN-list and IN-query. Source and canonical temporary view analysis, with gdesc controls for indeterminate-output view restrictions.
actual_attempts.result: 308 Valid cases had matching catalog output collation. Twelve remaining Valid cases cannot persist an indeterminate-collation view column but both SELECT forms analyze successfully; those are not false-Valid objections. No source/canonical divergence found.

actual_attempts.name: statement-wide parameters and canonical contracts
actual_attempts.method: PREPARE with explicit types then EXECUTE gdesc; source/canonical descriptions and contract reports compared. Environments cover int,bigint,text,varchar(4),numeric(6,2),char(3),name,text?, repeated/reordered numbered slots and anonymous slots across CTE/SubLink/substring boundaries.
actual_attempts.result: All source/canonical descriptions and contract reports agree. Native parameter typmod erasure agrees with reported varchar/numeric/bpchar outputs.

actual_attempts.name: recursive-reference contexts and CTE scope
actual_attempts.method: Independent anchor/step, derived-table, outer-join, set-operation, nested/unused WITH and expression-SubLink probes; source/canonical native gdesc only.
actual_attempts.result: No Valid case rejected by native analysis and no source/canonical descriptor divergence.

actual_attempts.name: unquoted Unicode boundary controls
actual_attempts.result: Six unquoted Unicode cases are outside typed-parser syntax; quoted Unicode label preserves native spelling. No admitted discrepancy.

actual_attempts.name: focused Python tests and wiring inspection
actual_attempts.result: 43 tests passed in 2.686s, exit 0. Inspected check_subqueries_cli.py source/canonical oracle pairs, descriptor gdesc separation, PREPARE/planning/execution boundaries, recursion guards, strict registry counts, and .github/workflows/ci.yml invocation. No concrete silent omission established.

nonblockingnotes: All repository reads and CLI runs used the frozen snapshot. No Lake command, shared artifact mutation, CLI mutation, repository edit, or authentic corpus SQL/DDL execution was performed. Native private clusters were temporary and removed by the connection helper.
Evidence files contain independently authored probes, not source-corpus originals. The copied CLI SHA256 was verified against the task pin.

The first exploratory descriptor harness accidentally retained canonical semicolons, so that initial canonical path executed independently authored SELECTs before gdesc; that comparison was discarded and the entire 94-case phase was rerun with terminating semicolons removed. Only corrected saved descriptor results support the review.
The temporary-view experiment is stricter than SELECT analysis for indeterminate output collations. Its twelve failures were explicitly rechecked by gdesc and not promoted to blockers.
This review is finite test evidence. It does not establish arbitrary native semantic equivalence, full PostgreSQL coverage, runtime error freedom, or discharge independent Lean/theorem claims.
